description.text:

•	Planned and managed annual $8M budget
•	Provided R&D support and oversight for 4 US/internal manufacturing sites, across ~15 product lines, maintaining a $1.3B revenue business.  
•	Balanced competing business priorities across manufacturing sites i.e., line down vs. patient impact

•	Led high priority remediation project across ~15 product families; team comprised of 150 engineers

- Executed Quality System updates; including development of Design Verification/Validation processes

-Provided Quality support to incorporate detailed biocompatibility requirements into a worldwide operating company procedure with focus on ISO 10993

-Implemented process improvements to eliminate errors in raw material receipt process
-Developed a method to track and release chemicals to support production through communication with contract testing labs

-Installed, manufactured, and enhanced a continuous glucose monitoring and delivery system; including work with hardware, software, and firmware to enhance the user experience

-Developed test protocols for accessory cables to quantify design requirments to meet FDA regulation

projects.title: Effect on Short-Term Estrogen Depletion on Compact Bone Microdensitometry in the Ewe
projects.subtitle: Sep 2011 - Dec 2012

description.text: Osteoporosis affects the human skeleton through the direct effects of the disease on the function and structure of bone.  The study objective was to quantify compact bone density present in ovine at three months post ovariectomy.  The results and conclusions within the study can be used to influence bone material characteristics and bone loss test protocols in future osteoporosis and estrogen depletion studies.
